events.description: Magazines, old maps, and a mountain of scrap paper. Cut first, decide later.
Draw a neighborhood that doesn't exist. Bonus points for naming the streets.
Hand-carved erasers and potato stamps. Ink gets everywhere. Wear the shirt you don't like.
One sheet, eight pages, one fold. You leave with a finished thing you can hand to somebody.
Make five, take five home. Bring your worst handwriting and your best joke.
Draw without looking at the paper. The whole point is that it goes badly.
